artworks.title: Two Shattered Trees; and Study for "The Road" [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a tree split and splintered, with detailed jagged lines illustrating its damaged condition. The drawing technique uses light and tentative pencil strokes, with more emphasis on the lines indicating the broken parts of the tree. The faintly suggested horizon features indistinct shapes that could be people or figures. In the background, less defined elements like another tree or structural formation are present. The color palette is monochromatic, using beige paper and gray pencil to create contrast and emphasize the rough texture of the drawing.

artworks.title: Catskill Mountains, Round-Top in the Distance; Catskills Looking North from Palenville; and Round Top, Catskills, from the Road to Bracketts [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Kate Bunner, wife of the artist)
artworks.description: This image features three pencil sketches of rural landscape scenes. The first sketch shows a mountain in the distance, framed by trees. The second sketch has a line of trees and a hill in the background. The third sketch shows an open field with trees and a mountain in the distance. The sketches are detailed with fine brushstrokes and a monochromatic color palette.

artworks.title: Osteria
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a landscape scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is situated near the upper third of the image, visible as a distant line of hills or low mountains beneath a sky filled with scattered, soft clouds. The artwork features fine, detailed lines that create texture and depth, particularly in the foliage and the outlines of the buildings. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey. Closest to us, there's a patch of textured ground leading to a small group of trees and a building with an archway. Beyond the structure, a few figures can be seen engaging with horses near a cart. Further back, there's another tree and more open land stretching towards the hills in the background.

artworks.title: Monte Circello
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a coast, a hill, figures, animals, mountains, a sailboat, and a tree, depicted in a detailed etching style with a monochrome color palette.

artworks.title: Rocca di Mezzo
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills, rocky outcrops, and a sky with swirling clouds. A group of figures, including a standing figure with a walking stick, a dog, and a seated pair, are in the foreground. Trees partially obscure the view, leading towards mountainous forms in the distance. The scene is rendered in fine etched lines, creating a monochromatic color palette of various shades of gray.

artworks.title: Olevano
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape in an etching technique with detailed line work and shading. Mountains dominate the upper portion, creating depth. Figures near a tree and a rock are visible. The image features a monochromatic palette with dark trees, a lighter sky, and shaded elements.

artworks.title: Ponte Salaro
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view with a clear perspective leading towards the center. The horizon line is low, with clouds covering the sky. A stone bridge with crenelated towers is centrally placed, slightly elevated. Two figures walk on a dirt path to the left of the bridge, accompanied by a dog. In the distance are horseback riders and another figure. The scene is depicted in black-and-white etching with fine, precise lines detailing the landscape and sky. The color palette is monochrome, using varying intensities of black and gray.

artworks.title: Castel Gandalfo
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high with clouds above and a castle-like structure in the distance, likely Castel Gandolfo. Figures, including a woman and a child, along with animals, are near a small spring with a cloth and cross. A large tree stands in the center. The artwork's color palette is limited to black, white, and gray, typical of etchings. Vegetation and hills are visible in the background, creating a serene countryside setting.

artworks.title: Studies of a Woman and Her Dress [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite with white chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II)
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person showing a partial profile view of the face and upper body. The face features light outlines of the nose, lips, and one eye. The person's hair is styled with a scarf or cloth, and the clothing includes flowing fabric around the neck and upper arm. The hands are positioned together in a relaxed manner, and the background is a plain, neutral tone.

artworks.title: A Lady Wearing a Dormeuse Cap
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image: 18.7 × 15.5 cm (7 3/8 × 6 1/8 in.)
sheet: 32.1 × 21.1 cm (12 5/8 × 8 5/16 in.) (folded along bottom)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ivan and Winifred Phillips in Honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: The drawing shows a woman from the waist up, positioned at a slight angle. Her facial features are delicately sketched with a subtle smile and inquisitive eyes. She has styled hair in an updo, with curls framing her face, and wears a bonnet with lace and floral decorations. She is dressed in a modest neckline dress with lace trim. The background is minimal and softly shaded, highlighting the woman as the main focus.

artworks.title: Studies of Figures [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite and charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II)
artworks.description: The drawing features a scene with linear perspective gridlines and architectural elements in the top portion. The bottom portion includes two sketch studies of figures in different poses and a detail of a hand. The drawing has an unfinished quality with guide lines and faint outlines.

artworks.title: Study of a Farmer [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II)
artworks.description: The image displays a sketch of the upper portion of a person, showing only their head, shoulders, and a bit of their upper torso. The person is depicted in a resting position, with their left elbow resting on an unseen surface and their head slightly turned to the right. The facial features are lightly sketched, and the person is wearing a wide-brimmed hat. The hair is partially shaded under the hat, with minimal detail. They are dressed in a garment with a discernible collar, which could be a shirt. There is no jewelry or other objects visibly held by the person. The background is plain, with no distinct details, focused only on the lightly rendered sketch against an unadorned surface.

artworks.title: Devastated Trees [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: The image features a pencil sketch of a landscape with trees. The composition shows a few trees scattered across a field, with the horizon positioned slightly above the center. The trees vary in size and detail, with some appearing as tall bare branches and others as smaller stumps. A detailed tree is depicted on the left, while the distant trees are sketched with lighter lines to create depth. The monochrome palette uses shades of pencil gray on cream-colored paper. The sketch is minimalistic and sparse, giving it a simple and unfinished look.

artworks.title: Frontispiece with Portrait of Saint Francis
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Domenico Falcini (engraver) , Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person positioned in a central frame, with their hands raised slightly to shoulder height. The person's facial features include a prominent beard and deep-set eyes, and their hair is short and slightly tousled. They appear to be depicted with a halo around their head. The person is wearing a robe with a simple design. The surrounding area is richly decorated with intricate designs, including shields, crests, and religious symbolism. Above the person, there is a cherub-like face. The background is filled with complex detailing of religious regalia, including papal crowns, swords, and other emblematic motifs.

artworks.title: View of the Mountain of La Verna from the Road of Casentino (Vue de la montagne della Vernia...) [plate A]
artworks.medium: etching with burin retouching on 3 joined sheets
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rocky cliffs, a winding path through a forest, and tree canopies with structures. The artwork is detailed with engravings depicting rocks, trees, and sky using a monochromatic palette of black and white. Birds fly in the sky, while small figures are seen on the path below.

artworks.title: Spring of Saint Francis (Fonte di San Francesco) [plate B]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded landscape from a slightly elevated angle. In the foreground, there is a rocky area leading to a small open courtyard with two figures. To the left, there is a two-story building with a gabled roof and a chimney, next to a larger brick structure resembling an archway or entrance. In the distance, beyond the courtyard and buildings, a herd of sheep is grazing amidst tall trees. The horizon is high, emphasizing the depth of the forest. The etching technique is detailed, creating texture in tree bark and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with black lines on pale paper.

artworks.title: The Salutation of the Birds (Il Saluto degli uccelli) [plate C]
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated point of view looking down on a sloping ground leading to a busy area. Trees obscure the horizon, with a flock of birds flying above them. The style is detailed, resembling etching or engraving, with intricate textures. In the foreground, there is a rocky formation and a channel lined with stones. Figures interact with the environment near a building and trees in the background. The scene is monochrome, emphasizing the detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: View of the Quadrant: the Main Door, the Square, the Church and the Loggia of the Monastery of the Monte della Vernia (Prospettiva dell'ingresso della prima porta, con la Piazza, Chiesa, & Loggie del Monastero del Monte della Vernia, come sta quest'Anno MDCXII) [plate D]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.medium: engraving on two sheets joined vertically
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural scene with a series of buildings forming a complex. The buildings have tiled rooftops and a central bell tower. The background is filled with trees. The structures are detailed with textures of brick and stone. In the foreground, there is a courtyard with a pavilion and people, as well as a person on a horse-drawn cart. On the left, there is a colonnaded porch with figures. The image is depicted in a monochrome palette of gray shades.

artworks.title: Façade of the Minor Church (Facciata della chiesa minore) [plate E]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural facade. The image shows a building with a flat-tiled roof, arched windows, a grand entrance with ornate columns, a half-circle window above the entrance, and decorative elements such as crosses and fleur-de-lis. A crescent shape with a small flag sits atop the pediment. A bell is visible in an arched window on one side. In front of the entrance, two figures are standing in conversation, while another figure stands in an arched doorway nearby. In the foreground, two reclining figures are depicted. The drawing highlights the textures of the stone and architectural details through intricate line work and shading.

artworks.title: Interior of the Minor Church (Interno della chiesa minore) [plate F]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.medium: engraving with an engraved overslip showing the addition of an altar screen
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The drawing is of an interior with religious elements. It features a detailed depiction of a chapel or religious space. The scene includes a high arched ceiling, an altar with a crucifix, and a decorative panel showing a religious scene. The architecture includes ornate arches and wall panels with intricate designs. In the foreground, three figures are conversing. The drawing is done in a classical style with attention to perspective and line work, highlighting depth and spatial arrangement in the room.

artworks.title: Exterior View of the Chapel of the Cardinal (Veduta esterna della cappella del cardinale) [plate G]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.medium: engraving with an engraved overslip of a rock revealing stairs when lifted
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image is a black and white engraving showing a stone structure in a forest. The viewpoint is elevated, revealing the roof of the building and trees around it. The horizon is not visible due to dense foliage. The architectural structure appears to be a small rustic house or tower, partially hidden by trees and rocky terrain. The engraving technique employs detailed cross-hatching and stippling to depict textures of leaves, tree bark, and stones. The grayscale color scheme focuses on shading to create depth. Large rocks and trees are in the foreground, with shadows from the canopy above. In the background, more trees and trunks suggest a thick forest, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Interior of the Chapel of Mary Magdelene (Interno della cappella della Maddalena) [plate H]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures within a large room or structure. The scene depicts two figures seated on a bench in front of an ornate structure or altar, which is central in the image. The altar features a framed image within it, showing a kneeling figure holding a cross. Below the altar, there is an inscription with decorative elements, and in front of it, two additional figures are kneeling, both holding or gesturing with rods toward a grid-like structure. The room seems to have a high vaulted ceiling. The artwork's intricate details in linework and shading suggest a focus on depth and perspective.

artworks.title: The Prominent Rock (Sasso spicco) [plate I]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky cliffside with trees growing on its edges. The perspective is slightly elevated, emphasizing the trees at the top of the image. The horizon is not visible. The artwork features detailed linework creating textures of rocks and tree bark. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray and black. Closest to us are jagged rocks, while further away, the trees fill the space with their intertwined branches and dense foliage.

artworks.title: Plan of the Rooms and Church of the Sacred Monastery (Pianta di parte della loggia e del sacro eremo) [plate K]
artworks.artist: Jacopo Ligozzi (artist), Anonymous engraver possibly Domenico Falcini, Lino Moroni (author)
artworks.creditLine: Acquisition funded by a grant from The B.H. Breslauer Foundation, 2013
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural floor plan integrated into a natural landscape. The drawing shows a top-down view of a structure with various rooms and walls labeled with letters. The structure is situated on sloping terrain, as indicated by the gradients and lines representing elevation. The surrounding area includes natural features like cliffs and wooden textures, suggesting it is built into an elevated hillside. The drawing includes shading and textures to highlight terrain contours and structural design elements, giving the impression of a well-planned architectural design that blends with its natural surroundings.
